reference_definition: All renewal application orders observed before the fixed application cutoff, all terms, independent of funding/maturity/current state; valid same-order approved-credit score, grouped by latest pre-application approved credit month.
target_definition: Existing mature funded renewal cohort and fixed score bands; current states 7/8.
percentile_definition: CDF inclusive: count of valid same-credit-month same-model reference orders with score<=target score / all valid reference orders for that month and model
summary_definition: Map individual order scores to the matched monthly CDF first, then order-weighted median/quantiles across target orders; never pool raw scores across months to build one CDF
score_time_limit: model_result_copy has no score timestamp or immutable version, so historical overwrites cannot be independently ruled out
